newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish finmin proposes FIM 17 bln budget deficit.
newsitem.headline: Finnish finmin proposes FIM 17 bln budget deficit.

text.p: The finance ministry's budget proposal for 1998 puts the deficit at 17 billion markka, some four billion markka below earlier estimates, Finance Minister Sauli Niinisto told a news conference on Tuesday.
He said total spending would be about 188 billion markka, which is three billion markka below earlier estimates.
The unemployment rate would fall to 15 percent this year and 13.5 percent next year, compared to an earlier forecast of 14.4 percent and 13.0 percent respectively, he said.
No further forecasts were immediately available.
